decision.summary: A transient E-component offset (indices 618–624) is observed with associated U-spike/dip and negligible N response. The offset does not fully return within the allowed context; thus status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets are confirmed in [580,660].

intervals.observation: E-component shows a multi-sample drop (indices ~618–622) with partial recovery but no clear return to pre-event trend by index 624; U-component exhibits a coincident spike-dip pair; N-component shows only a subtle inflection (<1 MAD). Return is unobserved within allowed context [580,660].
